items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Babe and I Dave Reynolds was talking about that tonight.

ctx.x: In those days, Stan, there were people they called the mothers. They called themselves, no, they didn't call themselves, I guess we gave them the name of the mothers. And I think that was one of the most important things in the music business. Babe and I Dave Reynolds was talking about that tonight. They prepared the food for you and the food was the best food they could buy, you know. It was clean and it was good food. It was raised, it like you say you raised maybe whatever the thing was, maybe a nickel and…
When you call them the mothers, who were they?
